# Documentation

- [Deploy from AWS Marketplace](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/deployment/aws-marketplace): Run a preconfigured Lamassu IoT instance on Amazon EC2.
- [Deploy Lamassu](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/deployment/overview): Choose the operating model that fits your infrastructure and control requirements.
- [Use Lamassu as SaaS](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/deployment/saas): Consume Lamassu as a managed service without operating your own infrastructure.
- [Fastlane](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/deployment/self-hosted/fastlane): Bootstrap a complete Lamassu evaluation or lab environment on an existing Kubernetes cluster.
- [Install with Helm](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/deployment/self-hosted/helm): Prepare dependencies, configure the Lamassu chart and verify a controlled Kubernetes deployment.
- [Expose the Gateway](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/deployment/self-hosted/networking): Choose how clients reach Lamassu, when to set gateway.addresses and how to design multiple Gateways.
- [Kubernetes self-managed](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/deployment/self-hosted/overview): Choose an installation workflow and network architecture for Lamassu on your Kubernetes cluster.
- [Deployment troubleshooting](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/deployment/troubleshooting): Diagnose access, service health and infrastructure dependencies.
- [Data model](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/administration/access-control/data-model): Entities and relationships from the pki.json schema that authz uses to evaluate access policies.
- [Access control overview](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/administration/access-control): Design who can access Lamassu through principals, policies, resource permissions and HTTP route authorization.
- [Alerts and subscriptions](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/administration/alerts): Send PKI events to people and external systems.
- [Audit logs](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/administration/audit-logs): Understand which audit events Lamassu generates and how to turn them into a durable trail.
- [Platform architecture](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/concepts/architecture): Lamassu components and how control, keys, issuance and devices relate.
- [How Lamassu works](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/concepts/overview): The mental model of trust, keys, certificates and devices.
- [Devices and identities](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/device-management): Register, inspect and retire devices while checking their current identity and history.
- [Configure and operate the DMS](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/enrollment/dms): Define registration, authentication per operation, issuance, renewal and distributed trust.
- [Enrollment with PKI](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/enrollment/overview): Prepare device admission, registration policy and certificate issuance.
- [Provisioning strategies](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/enrollment/provisioning-strategies): Choose device registration, identity authorization and key generation.
- [Authentication and trust](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/est/bootstrap-identity): Prepare credentials, authentication and trust distribution for EST.
- [EST in Lamassu](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/est/configuration): Configure EST operations, authentication and trust distribution.
- [EST Reference](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/est): The Enrollment over Secure Transport protocol defined by RFC 7030.
- [Enrollment troubleshooting](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/est/troubleshooting): Locate transport, authentication, registration, issuance and installation failures.
- [AWS IoT Core](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/integrations/aws-iot-core): Lamassu's connector for AWS IoT Core syncs device identities with the AWS platform, handling CA registration, Thing provisioning and certificate lifecycle automatically and event-driven.
- [IoT Fleets](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/overview): Organize devices and their identities, prepare enrollment and integrate consumers.
- [Enroll and connect your first device](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/quickstarts/enroll-device): Obtain an identity through EST, verify its association and use it in an mTLS connection.
- [Register a device manually](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/iot-fleets/quickstarts/register-device): Prepare a DMS, register a device and associate a verified certificate with its identity.
- [Lamassu IoT Platform](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/overview): Build a PKI and apply its certificates to your devices' lifecycle.
- [CA hierarchy and rotation](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/ca-hierarchy-and-rotation): Design root and intermediate authorities and replace certificates or keys without breaking trust.
- [Certification authorities](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/certificate-authorities): Create, import and operate the authorities that establish your PKI's trust.
- [Certificate profiles](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/certificate-profiles): Define reusable policies to issue consistent certificates and constrain accepted keys.
- [Certificate validation](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/certificate-validation): Check chain, identity, purpose and revocation from the consumer.
- [Certificates](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/certificates): Inspect, download and revoke the certificates issued by Lamassu.
- [Certificate lifecycle](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/concepts/certificate-lifecycle): Issuance, use, renewal, revocation and retirement of certificates in Lamassu.
- [Trust model](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/concepts/trust-model): Understand where trust originates, how it is distributed and what each component validates.
- [Revocation lists (CRL)](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/crl): Generate and distribute signed lists to validate certificates offline.
- [Enrollment protocols](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/enrollment-protocols): Request and renew certificates from a Lamassu CA.
- [Keys and cryptographic engines](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/key-management): Generate, import and operate keys without coupling the PKI to a specific provider.
- [Online validation with OCSP](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/ocsp): Query signed status and verify the responder’s response.
- [PKI](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/overview): Administer keys and authorities, define issuance and verify the resulting certificates.
- [Create your first CA](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/quickstarts/create-certificate-authority): Create an evaluation root and check its certificate before issuing.
- [Issue and verify a certificate](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/quickstarts/issue-certificate): Issue a client certificate and check content, chain and key correspondence.
- [PKI getting started](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/quickstarts/overview): Create a CA, issue a client certificate and check its chain and key.
- [PKI troubleshooting](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/platform/pki/troubleshooting): Diagnose certificate issuance, OCSP and CRL.
- [Security](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/security): How to report a security vulnerability in Lamassu privately, what to include in a report and which releases receive security fixes.
- [3.8.0 to 4.0.0](/docs/pr-preview/pr-78/upgrades/3-8-0-to-4-0-0): What changes in 4.0.0, which changes break 3.8.0 API clients, event consumers and devices, how to upgrade a Helm release step by step and how to validate the result.
